top.line: If you copy and paste between AI sessions, you are the wire between your agents, and the bottleneck.
top.para: Let agents talk through recorded channels, scale decisions with structure, read outputs.

in-short.line: The trap, reading, channels, structure, two altitudes, and what we sell.

trap.line: Carrying text between sessions makes the person the network, and the limit.

reading.line: Reading everything does not scale and leaves you always behind.
reading.para: Vicky's shift came when she stopped.

channels.line: Vault lanes, repository files and commit messages, every message signed.
channels.para: Maximum provenance; one message reached every conductor.

structure.line: Guidance, decision trees and graphs, a board, decision records, outputs.
structure.para: You write the top and read the middle.

altitudes.line: Direction for the team, depth where your expertise matters.
altitudes.para: It empowers agency instead of removing it.

sell.line: AgentiCCells sets up the team, the channels and the workflows.
sell.para: With specialist agents on call: a possible on-demand service.

limits.line: Our channels; an idea for specialists; Vicky described, not quoted.
